title: Sable and the Contact
author: Sable Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Whitlock, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
